entries.title: Doctorate, Louisiana Tech University
entries.text: Major in marketing; double minor in psychology and quantitative analysis. American Marketing Association Doctoral Consortium Fellow and National Conference of Sales Management Doctoral Fellow.

entries.title: Joins IIM Ahmedabad
entries.text: Faculty at the institute until 28 February 2019.

entries.title: Appointed Director of IIM Rohtak
entries.text: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet, headed by the Prime Minister, makes the appointment. The same round named directors for ten IIMs.

entries.title: Leaves IIM Ahmedabad
entries.text: His service at the institute is recorded as ending on this date.

entries.title: Exemplary Governance Leadership Award
entries.text: One of seven recipients at the 46th World Management Congress, India International Centre, New Delhi.
